name: Craterline GP
pitch: Moon-rim bike racing: a seven-lap cup against five rivals, with route splits, checkpoints and a rescue budget.

name: Chroma Roll
pitch: Colour-gate ball runner: switch colour to pass gates, grab power-ups and avoid the splatter game over.

name: Serpentine Sky Run
pitch: Endless runner on a winding sky road: eight stages with boost rungs, roll sections and traffic hazards (outbound run).

name: Gridlock Courier
pitch: Arcade drift driving through a block city: coin pickups, 84 traffic cars, bloom and a chase camera.

name: Ion Circuit
pitch: Anti-gravity time trial with boost pads, pickups, barrels and heat management. Time Trial mode.

name: Shadowstep Gauntlet
pitch: Lane-running combat with a dozen skinned clones, form changes and a full course finish.

name: Lamplight Line
pitch: Tram-driving loop with day and night, passengers, fares and tips: balance the lean and keep every rider happy.

name: Saltwind Highway
pitch: Coastal highway drive with jumps, traffic and relay gates: 33 to 35 vehicles per route in batched meshes, with sun shadows, sky and ocean.

name: The Bellkeeper's Walk
pitch: Meadow walk: collect three letters and ring the bell, with a boat epilogue, a journal and audio.

name: Duneglide
pitch: Free-ride flight over a silt world, through ring beacons; the first chapter has real colliders.

name: Cumulus Dash
pitch: Obstacle runner on a cloud: creatures, boulders, a duel and a finale, with audio.
